request.text: Check whether it will rain in Suzhou on Sunday morning. Only if the forecast says rain, set a reminder for 8:00 tonight to tell Chen to bring an umbrella.

responsibilities.outcome: Check whether the forecast for Suzhou on Sunday morning indicates rain.
Only if the Suzhou Sunday-morning forecast indicates rain, create a reminder for 8:00 tonight to tell Chen to bring an umbrella.

semantic_facts: The plan must first obtain the Suzhou forecast for Sunday morning and use whether it indicates rain as the condition for the reminder branch.
The 8:00-tonight reminder to tell Chen to bring an umbrella may be created only when that forecast condition is satisfied.
forbidden_claims: The planner creates the reminder unconditionally or treats an unknown forecast as evidence of rain.
The planner invents a forecast result before weather evidence is returned or changes the reminder time, recipient, or umbrella content.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A conditional stateful effect is flattened into an unconditional reminder before its evidence-producing lookup completes.
Arguments from the weather branch leak into or overwrite the reminder's independently specified time, recipient, or content.
